recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical white central column containing a portrait of a man and woman in ornate western wear, flanked by two large solid terracotta-red side panels. The layout uses a stark three-column grid with heavy emphasis on verticality and mid-century sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Central white column acts as a window into the photographic scene.
Solid red side panels provide a high-contrast frame for the central imagery.
Typography is strictly contained within the white column or aligned to the bottom of the red panels.
The subjects' yellow-tan embroidered suits contrast against the dark green foliage and red background.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are seated in the lower half of the central white column, medium-full shot, leaning against a tree.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large blue display text at the top of the central column.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the blue title, moves down through the black subtitle, and rests on the subjects' faces in the photograph.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space provided by the solid red side panels and the white space above the photo.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red panels, muted natural tones in the photograph, and bright primary blue for the title.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Ampersand is significantly smaller and centered between names
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Condensed bold display paired with a standard-width medium weight sans-serif for secondary information.

preserve: Condensed nature of the blue text
Centered alignment in the white column

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, flat-terminal look of the blue title.
Provides the clean, mid-century subtitle look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a three-column layout. The left and right columns are solid terracotta red. The center column is white. In the bottom two-thirds of the center column, place a photograph of a man and woman in yellow western suits with cactus embroidery, sitting against a large tree in a wooded park setting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: In the top third of the white column, add large condensed bold sans-serif text in sky blue. Below that, add two lines of medium-weight black sans-serif text. Ensure all text is centered horizontally within the white column.

verificationChecks: Is the layout divided into three distinct vertical sections?
Is the title text sky blue and condensed?
Are the side panels solid terracotta red?
Is the photograph contained strictly within the white center column?

adjustableVariables: Hue of the red side panels
Specific embroidery patterns on the western wear
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Record label logos in the corners
Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check that the red panels are perfectly vertical and solid.
Ensure the blue text is the largest typographic element.
Verify the subjects are wearing western-style clothing.
Confirm the white column has significant breathing room around the text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a central vertical photograph, frame it with two solid high-saturation color blocks, and place bold condensed sans-serif typography in the white space above the image.
